card: Adds a getMemoryLoad() IPC mining interface method to report the memory footprint of active block templates held by external clients. BlockTemplateManager tracks live templates through weak references and estimates memory consumed by their internal containers and any transactions they pin that have since left the node mempool. This addresses memory tracking discussed in issue #33899 to allow Stratum v2 template providers to detect memory buildup and release stale templates.
changed_since_previous: Switched BlockTemplateManager ownership in NodeContext to std::shared_ptr so client-side templates can safely lock a weak_ptr during unregistration at shutdown, updated WaitAndCreateNewBlock to take CBlockTemplate by reference, and added unit tests for shutdown lifetime handling and accounting sanity checks.
evidence: PR description references #33899: 'IPC clients can hold block templates indefinitely, keeping transactions alive after they leave the mempool. This adds getMemoryLoad() to estimate the memory held on behalf of all mining clients, as discussed in bitcoin/bitcoin#33899.'
Author links external client adoption in stratum-mining/sv2-tp#63.
problem: External mining clients, such as Stratum v2 template providers, can hold block templates indefinitely via IPC. Because templates hold `CTransactionRef` pointers, transactions evicted from the mempool stay pinned in memory without any visibility for clients or the node into the resulting memory load.

risk.why: A race condition or lock inversion between mempool checks, template registration, and asynchronous template destruction during node shutdown could cause crashes or deadlocks.

scope_notes: Changes `NodeContext::block_template_manager` from `std::unique_ptr` to `std::shared_ptr` to manage asynchronous template destructor calls during shutdown.
summary: Adds a `getMemoryLoad()` method to the IPC mining interface to estimate the memory footprint of block templates held by external clients. `BlockTemplateManager` tracks active templates via weak references and calculates aggregate memory usage from template structures plus referenced transactions that are no longer present in the mempool. It also converts `BlockTemplateManager` ownership to `std::shared_ptr` so template cleanup can complete safely if an IPC client disconnects during node shutdown.
